theory.intro: Mass units are linked by factors of $1000$. Convert by multiplying or dividing by $1000$.
facts: Going to a **smaller** unit (kg→g, t→kg): **multiply** by $1000$.
Going to a **larger** unit (g→kg, kg→t): **divide** by $1000$.
steps: Decide if the new unit is smaller or larger.
Smaller unit → multiply by $1000$; larger unit → divide by $1000$.
Move the digits three places (or the decimal point).

development.question_text: Which is greater: $0.9\text{ t}$ or $920\text{ kg}$?
development.solution_text:
$0.9\text{ t}=900\text{ kg}$
$900\text{ kg}<920\text{ kg}$
$920\text{ kg}$ is greater.

mastery.question_text: Order $1.05\text{ t}$, $1040\text{ kg}$ and $1.004\text{ t}$ from lightest to heaviest.
A student converts $37\text{ g}$ to $0.37\text{ kg}$. Correct the answer and explain the error.
mastery.solution_text:
$37\div1000\text{ kg}$
$=0.037\text{ kg}$
The student divided by $100$ instead of $1000$.
